summary: Booster 19 was the first Block 3 Super Heavy to fly, replacing Booster 18, which was lost in ground testing. On Flight 12 its boostback and landing burns failed and it hit the Gulf of Mexico.

history.event: 10-engine static fire, the first at OLP-2 and the first Raptor 3 static fire on a booster
33-engine static fire, cut short by a flame diverter issue
Launched on Flight 12; lost after failed boostback and landing burns
